# tlottie

This directory contains `tlottie.wasm`, copied without modification from
[`dkaraush/tlottie`](https://github.com/dkaraush/tlottie) commit
[`758c7cb74444f1c3c9923065c40fdb3aad8b7d60`](https://github.com/dkaraush/tlottie/tree/758c7cb74444f1c3c9923065c40fdb3aad8b7d60),
`examples/web/tlottie.wasm`.

The upstream package declares the MIT license in `Cargo.toml`. Telegram Web A
lists tlottie as one of its animation dependencies. The bundled Lottie data in
`src/tlottie-orbit.json` is the upstream `examples/android/app/src/main/assets/sample.json`, reformatted only.
